metadata.title: German A1 Verbs
metadata.scope: Expanded A1 verb curriculum based on Goethe A1 exam and course vocabulary; not an official exhaustive CEFR list.
notes: Goethe specifies present-tense knowledge for all verbs in its A1 word list, selected perfect and past forms, modal verbs, separable-prefix verbs, and imperative forms.
This application dataset intentionally provides more complete paradigms so learners can enable or disable form categories in settings.
Some verbs can take haben or sein depending on meaning and context; the listed auxiliary is the most useful default for the included A1 sense.
Native-speaker editorial review is recommended before production release, especially for example sentences, valency, and less common imperatives.
